source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-11

procedures.title: Three-speed transmission: remove (Corvette)
steps: Take off the console trim plate (see Corvette Body, Section 1A, Passenger Service Manual).
Put the car on a hoist.
Remove both exhaust pipes completely; with 396 or 427 cu. in. engines the forward stud on each manifold must come out first.
Uncouple the propshaft at the transmission slip yoke, lower its front end, and pull the slip yoke out of the transmission.
Remove the bolts joining the rear mount to its bracket, then raise the engine to lift the transmission off the bracket.
Remove the bolts holding the linkage mounting bracket to the frame.
Unbolt the gearshift assembly from the mounting bracket, remove the bracket, and take out the shifter with its rods still attached.
Disconnect the shifter levers at the transmission and the speedometer cable.
Unbolt the mount bracket from the crossmember and remove it; remove the bolts holding the rear mount cushion and exhaust pipe yoke.
Remove the transmission-to-clutch housing bolts and the bottom extension bolt.

Draw the transmission back and turn it clockwise until it clears the clutch housing; for room, lower the rear of the engine slowly until the tachometer drive cable at the distributor just clears the horizontal ledge across the front of the dash.
Slide the transmission rearward out of the clutch, tip its front end down, and lower it out of the car.
Install by doing these steps in reverse order.
notes: Caution: the tachometer cable is easily damaged if it hits the dash hard.
